help.desc:
**Hello :wave:**, I'm **%s**!
I'm the music bot your server needs! I can play songs from **Spotify**, **SoundCloud**, **Twitch**, and [much more](https://kenabot.xyz)!

**Commands**
You can see the information on all of my commands **[here](https://kenabot.xyz/commands)** or by clicking the button below!

**Premium/Donations**
The **[KenaBot for Donors](https://kenabot.xyz/premium)** version will give you access to news features and enhancements, such as **24/7**, **audio effects** and a **web player!!
[Click here to learn more](https://kenabot.xyz/premium)

**Add me to your server**
You can add me to as many servers as you want by clicking **[here](https://discord.com/api/oauth2/authorize?client_id=%s&permissions=3534272&scope=bot%20applications.commands)** or on the button!

**Support Server**
On my support server you will find all kinds of help and more information about me, you can join by clicking **[here](https://kenabot.xyz/support)** or on the button!

config.description:
**Hello** :wave: welcome to the bot configuration assistant <@!%s>

If you have any questions about the bot and its configuration, you can go to my **[support server](https://kenabot.xyz/soporte)** or check my **[web page](https://kenabot.xyz)**

Open the menu to choose the language in which you want the bot messages to be displayed.

If you don't see your language you can join my [support server](https://kenabot.xyz/soporte) and contribute as a translator!

embed.title: Embed colour configuration
embed.description:
Open the menu to choose the embed colour that will be shown in all the bot's messages.

This menu has only default colours, if you want to use a custom colour you can go to my [dashboard web](https://kenabot.xyz/dashboard).
